text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I thought I heard someone calling for 
Falco over here, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that Falco's fans and I just 
ended up passing each other by?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Three Goddesses~! Did you happen to see 
anything?
